title: Case Splits and Missing Receipts: Exception Handling for Snack-Brand Order Agents
summary: A snack-brand Genie pauses on an unapproved repack or a missing receipt, keeps its partial packet in Postgres, and resumes only on same-shipment evidence.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Design the snack-brand agent’s stop conditions around ambiguous pack conversions, split deliveries, and missing receipts. The exception path should preserve a partially complete investigation and request the exact missing fact. A Genie must not fill a document gap with a plausible narrative or infer that a case split was approved because the totals appear close.


Explore the complete[packaged food and snacks integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/packaged-food-snacks) for the systems and processes around this guide.
